-- Parse address: split into street and house_number -- Pattern: "Rue de la Paix 12B" -> street="Rue de la Paix", house_number="12B" UPDATE address SET street = CASE WHEN address IS NOT NULL AND address ~ '\s+\d+[A-Za-z]*$' THEN TRIM(REGEXP_REPLACE(address, '\s+\d+[A-Za-z]*$', '')) ELSE address END, house_number = CASE WHEN address IS NOT NULL AND address ~ '\s+\d+[A-Za-z]*$' THEN TRIM(REGEXP_REPLACE(address, '^.*\s+(\d+[A-Za-z]*)$', '\1')) ELSE NULL END WHERE address IS NOT NULL;
-- Parse npa_localite: split into postal_code and city -- Pattern: "2944 Bonfol" -> postal_code="2944", city="Bonfol" UPDATE address SET postal_code = CASE WHEN npa_localite IS NOT NULL AND npa_localite ~ '^\d+\s+' THEN TRIM(SPLIT_PART(npa_localite, ' ', 1)) ELSE NULL END, city = CASE WHEN npa_localite IS NOT NULL AND npa_localite ~ '^\d+\s+' THEN TRIM(SUBSTRING(npa_localite FROM POSITION(' ' IN npa_localite) + 1)) ELSE npa_localite END WHERE npa_localite IS NOT NULL;

-- Parse address: split into street and house_number UPDATE address SET street = CASE WHEN address IS NOT NULL AND address REGEXP '.*\s+\d+[A-Za-z]*$' THEN TRIM(REGEXP_REPLACE(address, '\s+\d+[A-Za-z]*$', '')) ELSE address END, house_number = CASE WHEN address IS NOT NULL AND address REGEXP '.*\s+\d+[A-Za-z]*$' THEN TRIM(REGEXP_REPLACE(address, '^.*\s+(\d+[A-Za-z]*)$', '$1')) ELSE NULL END WHERE address IS NOT NULL;
-- Parse npa_localite: split into postal_code and city UPDATE address SET postal_code = CASE WHEN npa_localite IS NOT NULL AND npa_localite REGEXP '^\d+\s+.*' THEN TRIM(SUBSTRING(npa_localite, 1, LOCATE(' ', npa_localite) - 1)) ELSE NULL END, city = CASE WHEN npa_localite IS NOT NULL AND npa_localite REGEXP '^\d+\s+.*' THEN TRIM(SUBSTRING(npa_localite, LOCATE(' ', npa_localite) + 1)) ELSE npa_localite END WHERE npa_localite IS NOT NULL;

-- Create Address records for each exhibitor with address data INSERT INTO address (id, tenant_id, street, house_number, postal_code, city, iso_country) SELECT gen_random_uuid(), e.tenant_id, -- Parse street and house_number from address CASE WHEN e.address IS NOT NULL AND e.address ~ '\s+\d+[A-Za-z]*$' THEN TRIM(REGEXP_REPLACE(e.address, '\s+\d+[A-Za-z]*$', '')) ELSE e.address END as street, CASE WHEN e.address IS NOT NULL AND e.address ~ '\s+\d+[A-Za-z]*$' THEN TRIM(REGEXP_REPLACE(e.address, '^.*\s+(\d+[A-Za-z]*)$', '\1')) ELSE NULL END as house_number, -- Parse postal_code and city from npa_localite CASE WHEN e.npa_localite IS NOT NULL AND e.npa_localite ~ '^\d+\s+' THEN TRIM(SPLIT_PART(e.npa_localite, ' ', 1)) ELSE NULL END as postal_code, CASE WHEN e.npa_localite IS NOT NULL AND e.npa_localite ~ '^\d+\s+' THEN TRIM(SUBSTRING(e.npa_localite FROM POSITION(' ' IN e.npa_localite) + 1)) ELSE e.npa_localite END as city, COALESCE(e.iso_country, 'CH') as iso_country FROM exhibitor e WHERE e.address IS NOT NULL OR e.npa_localite IS NOT NULL;
-- Update exhibitor with new home_address_id UPDATE exhibitor e SET home_address_id = a.id FROM address a WHERE a.tenant_id = e.tenant_id AND ( (e.address IS NOT NULL AND a.street = CASE WHEN e.address ~ '\s+\d+[A-Za-z]*$' THEN TRIM(REGEXP_REPLACE(e.address, '\s+\d+[A-Za-z]*$', '')) ELSE e.address END) OR (e.npa_localite IS NOT NULL AND a.city = CASE WHEN e.npa_localite ~ '^\d+\s+' THEN TRIM(SUBSTRING(e.npa_localite FROM POSITION(' ' IN e.npa_localite) + 1)) ELSE e.npa_localite END) ) AND a.id NOT IN (SELECT DISTINCT billing_address_id FROM exhibitor WHERE billing_address_id IS NOT NULL) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM exhibitor e2 WHERE e2.home_address_id = a.id AND e2.id != e.id);

-- Create Address records for each exhibitor with address data INSERT INTO address (id, tenant_id, street, house_number, postal_code, city, iso_country) SELECT RANDOM_UUID(), e.tenant_id, -- Parse street and house_number from address CASE WHEN e.address IS NOT NULL AND e.address REGEXP '.*\s+\d+[A-Za-z]*$' THEN TRIM(REGEXP_REPLACE(e.address, '\s+\d+[A-Za-z]*$', '')) ELSE e.address END as street, CASE WHEN e.address IS NOT NULL AND e.address REGEXP '.*\s+\d+[A-Za-z]*$' THEN TRIM(REGEXP_REPLACE(e.address, '^.*\s+(\d+[A-Za-z]*)$', '$1')) ELSE NULL END as house_number, -- Parse postal_code and city from npa_localite CASE WHEN e.npa_localite IS NOT NULL AND e.npa_localite REGEXP '^\d+\s+.*' THEN TRIM(SUBSTRING(e.npa_localite, 1, LOCATE(' ', e.npa_localite) - 1)) ELSE NULL END as postal_code, CASE WHEN e.npa_localite IS NOT NULL AND e.npa_localite REGEXP '^\d+\s+.*' THEN TRIM(SUBSTRING(e.npa_localite, LOCATE(' ', e.npa_localite) + 1)) ELSE e.npa_localite END as city, COALESCE(e.iso_country, 'CH') as iso_country FROM exhibitor e WHERE e.address IS NOT NULL OR e.npa_localite IS NOT NULL;
-- Update exhibitor with new home_address_id -- Note: H2 has limitations with complex UPDATE FROM, so we use a simpler approach UPDATE exhibitor e SET home_address_id = ( SELECT a.id FROM address a WHERE a.tenant_id = e.tenant_id AND a.id NOT IN (SELECT DISTINCT billing_address_id FROM exhibitor WHERE billing_address_id IS NOT NULL) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM exhibitor e2 WHERE e2.home_address_id = a.id AND e2.id != e.id) ORDER BY a.id DESC LIMIT 1 ) WHERE e.address IS NOT NULL OR e.npa_localite IS NOT NULL;
